verdict.rationale: Kit documents a broad V4 API: broadcast create, read, update, delete, schedule and stats; custom fields including bulk operations; account, colors, creator profile and growth stats; webhooks; and OAuth. It also ships an official account-level MCP server that reads and writes subscribers, sequences, broadcasts, tags and segments. However, many UI features have no evidenced API equivalent, and Kit never claims full UI parity. Bulk processing covers only 'some common use cases', and no OpenAPI spec was found by probe. missing for 10: API coverage of visual automations, landing page/form building, A/B tests, polls, digital products/subscriptions, RSS campaigns, and an explicit parity statement or published OpenAPI spec.
